name: paper-plugin
description: Codex plugin for academic paper routing, reading, writing, citation, response, figure, data, and strict DOCX render-QA workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Academic paper routing, reading, writing, citation, DOCX render QA, response, and figure workflows

defaultPrompt: Route this paper or thesis task to the correct workflow before editing files.
